text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Attorney-general resigns. Cabinet ministers call for justice minister to do the same.
- Jordan's King Hussein suggested compromise for final Israeli redeployment. Netanyahu, Arafat agreed.
- Number of job-seekers grew by 18 percent in 1996; up in December by 7.1 percent.
- Hussein compromise may clinch Hebron deal.
- Manufacturers: Worst industrial quarter in seven years.
- Zim, Bezeq, Israel Chemicals, likely to top privatisation list.
- Cables of Zion, Cvalim begin merger talks.
- Israel's final redeployment in the West Bank will be completed by August 31, 1998.
- Trade deficit in 1996 hits record $10.5 billion.
